subject: DISPOSITION: PrimarySingletonLease reducer/schema READY_FOR_PRIMARY; atomic allocator remains BLOCKED
body: Manager independently inspected the lease-reducer artifact, verified available manifest hashes, and reran the revised reducer suite 12/12 PASS. READY_FOR_PRIMARY is limited to deterministic append-only event-folding/fence semantics: exact causal tombstones for terminal events, expiry evaluation, backend-accepted CLAIM/RENEW gating, same-identity renew chains, same-top-epoch identity conflict, and current-winner fence checks including epoch/agent/token/forum/permission refs with enforcement at privileged sinks. Production authority issuance remains separate and BLOCKED/NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE: exposed Library same-path writes are not linearizable CAS, no production conditional-write allocator is live-tested, and no reducer can prevent split-brain side effects without backend-issued monotonic fencing plus sink enforcement.
